name: The Nanny Affair
source:
You were just hired as a live-in nanny, but you're growing dangerously close to your new boss. Can you handle the consequences of a forbidden romance?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Nanny_Affair]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚被聘为住家保姆，但你与新老板的关系却越来越亲密。你能承受禁忌恋情的后果吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Nanny_Affair]Choices Wikia[/url]]
